These are exact original HTTP response bytes acquired on 2026-11-20 UTC.
Each accompanying provenance JSON records the URL, acquisition timestamp,
HTTP status, SHA-256, and byte count. No response values have been edited.

`sitca-nav.bin` is the UTF-8 BOM CSV published by SITCA, with 4,494 fund
records plus its header. The public dataset and licensing information is
https://data.gov.tw/dataset/11109 . `tai50.bin` and `taiextr.bin` are TWSE
OpenAPI JSON responses, each with 15 observations for November 2026.

This CSV is a latest NAV snapshot, not historical NAV coverage. The index
responses are partial month observations, not a complete historical series.
